survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note reports descriptive system indicators using data from OECD large-scale assessments and administrative/statistical sources (e.g., Survey of Adult Skills/PIAAC for literacy and unemployment/attainment patterns). The document does not provide microdata sampling details, replicate design information, or explicit application of complex survey weights (e.g., W_FSTUWT/TOTWGT) at the country-note level. Because the note is not an empirical student-level modeling study, it does not specify how analysts should apply survey weights when producing the reported percentages and gaps. For replication at the indicator level, users should consult the referenced Education at a Glance 2025 tables and the OECD Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes (and, for PIAAC-derived indicators, the PIAAC technical documentation) to identify the exact weighting and variance-estimation approach used for each indicator.

Missing-data handling is therefore not reported in the note because no original microdata modeling pipeline is specified here; instead, the note points to the underlying Education at a Glance 2025 tables and technical notes for indicator construction.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Switzerland summarizes education-system outcomes using the latest available indicator data, with emphasis on tertiary education. It reports cross-generational tertiary attainment differences (using adult attainment patterns), unemployment rates by educational attainment, and adult literacy proficiency distributions derived from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC). It also describes tertiary entry and completion patterns (e.g., entry pathways into bachelor’s programmes, completion within theoretical duration and follow-up timeframes), international student mobility trends, and education spending levels by education level. The note is descriptive: it does not specify student-level sampling, plausible-value (PV) procedures, missing-data handling, or any predictive modeling pipeline. For methodological details behind each indicator, the note directs readers to the Education at a Glance 2025 tables and the referenced Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This is not an empirical ML paper with an explicit student-level modeling design; it is a descriptive OECD country note that aggregates and reports indicator results. As a result, there is no analytic sample size, no PV-handling or missing-data strategy for an ML pipeline, and no ML algorithm comparison to extract. The note instead points to the underlying Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables and technical documentation for the indicator construction methodology.
